<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_VacationRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/vacation-request">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_VacationRequest" name="Vacation Request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Vacation request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterRequest" name="Register vacation request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_Register</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveRequest" name="Supervisor receives request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_Receive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DecideRequest" name="Supervisor approves or rejects request">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Decide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequestOutcome" name="Request outcome">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Decide_Outcome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" name="Return request to employee">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Rejected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" name="Review rejection reasons">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Return_Review</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Review_RejectedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Rejection reviewed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Review_RejectedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateHRNotification" name="Generate notification to Human Resources Representative">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Outcome_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" name="Complete vacation management procedures">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Notify_Procedures</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted" name="Management procedures completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_Register" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestSubmitted" targetRef="Task_RegisterRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Receive" sourceRef="Task_RegisterRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Decide" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRequest" targetRef="Task_DecideRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_DecideRequest" targetRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_Review" sourceRef="Task_ReturnRejectedRequest" targetRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_RejectedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReviewRejectionReasons" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Outcome_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RequestOutcome" targetRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Procedures" sourceRef="Task_GenerateHRNotification" targetRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procedures_ApprovedEnd" sourceRef="Task_CompleteHRProcedures" targetRef="EndEvent_ProceduresCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
